name: logos-osm
description: OpenStreetMap distribution on Logos: Geofabrik discovery, MD5-verified hosting to Logos Storage, the LEZ region registry, and a Basecamp host/consumer app.

components.name: osm
components.description: Headless OSM runtime module loaded by Logos Core (Qt plugin over FFI to the Rust SDK).

components.name: osm_app
components.description: Basecamp mini-app: host/registrar flow (discover, host, registration transactions) and consumer flow (fetch, verify, import, update check).
